entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Chiaramontan Gothic architecture is a regional variant of Sicilian Gothic that developed in the 14th century under the patronage and influence of the Chiaramonte family, particularly in western Sicily. It developed during the Aragonese period and is identified in the literature as architettura chiaramontana.
